title: Move bee's own verification skill into the source shape and prove it by driving one mapped feature
action:
The dogfood. bee ships a mechanism it does not itself use: its own verification skill sits hand-written at `.claude/skills/verify-bee/`, visible to Claude only, so a Codex or opencode agent in this very repo cannot see it. This cell puts bee in the shape every host now gets (per D7 2effbe54, D1 d0e3c3a0, D8 9f4f90f0).

This is mostly a MOVE, not authorship. The tree is `.claude/skills/verify-bee/` holding `SKILL.md`, an executable `control-bee`, and `features/` with a README index plus five feature files. Read `skills/bee-verifying/SKILL.md` FIRST — vif-3 rewrote it, and it is now the spec this tree must match.

1. Move the tree to `.bee/verify/verify-app/`, preserving `control-bee`'s executable bit (a git move keeps the mode; confirm with `ls -l`). Keep the control script named `control-bee` — the skill NAME is the constant, the script keeps the app's name, which is the form `skills/bee-verifying/SKILL.md` now shows.

2. The frontmatter `name:` becomes the literal `verify-app`. bee's identity moves into the `description`, which is what routing actually reads — the existing description already opens by naming the `bee` CLI, so check whether it needs anything at all before touching it.

3. Repoint every self-reference. `rg -n '\.claude/skills/verify-bee' .bee/verify/verify-app/` finds them — 6 in `SKILL.md`, 1 in `features/README.md` at the time of writing. `features/README.md` currently tells the reader to invoke the script by its literal path from the repo root; that path is now `.bee/verify/verify-app/control-bee`. Per the rule vif-3 moved into `bee-verifying`'s step-2 Helpers bullet, a RENDERED copy is `0644` and cannot be executed directly, so every invocation a skill body shows is written `bash <path> ...`; the source copy under `.bee/verify/` keeps its `0755` and runs either way. Make the shown form the one that works from both.

4. Delete the old tree at `.claude/skills/verify-bee` in the SAME commit, through git so the removal is staged. This is a must-have, not a tidy-up: `verify-bee` is not `bee-` prefixed, so bee's skill sync will never prune it (`packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/skills.rs` refuses outside the bee namespace) and the verify render path has no removal verb at all. Leave it and this repo carries two verification skills whose feature maps drift apart in silence.

5. Run `.bee/bin/bee onboard --apply` so the source renders into every runtime skill home as `verify-app`. Confirm all three exist and match source. If onboard refuses inside a granted worktree, record that as a deviation and render by whatever path the refusal names; if there is none, return [BLOCKED] with the refusal text. Never hand-copy a rendered tree.

6. PROVE IT LIVE. This is the only `green:live` in the whole feature and the only evidence the render path works on a real instance rather than in unit tests. Follow the skill's own instructions: build, launch a sandbox, run its doctor and require every line `ok`, drive ONE mapped feature end to end, capture the evidence, then run its cleanup. Confirm the evidence still exists at its named location after cleanup — a cleanup that eats the proof fails this step. Name the feature you drove and where the evidence landed in your outcome line.
